semantics: The resolving item controller selects exact own hand permanent cards, including lands, creatures, artifacts, enchantments, planeswalkers and any supported battle identities; instants/sorceries and foreign/stale/duplicate refs are ineligible.

Zero selections are legal; only the controller acts. Private candidate/selected identities and unfinished counts are unavailable to the other viewer; no selected card moves and no entry trigger is queued until Finish.

Finish revalidates exact selected refs and stages one simultaneous EntryMove batch. Ordinary replacement/prevention, Aura and as-entry copy choices apply to that batch. Simultaneous new objects are not pre-event Aura recipients or copy blueprints.

All entry choices complete before the next resolving instruction. Completed deployment metadata no longer intercepts a subsequent hand selector, while old public completed counts remain available until normal resolution cleanup.
Noncast permanent entrants use entry X=0. They are not cast, and no activation or spell parent chosen-X value is implicitly forwarded.
